_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 5% of 12h windows showing ±2+ score movement over 7 days, this is a statistical coil — HOLD is the honest default until funding spikes above 0.01% or DXY breaks 100.5 to confirm the breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — Analyst forward call is HOLD (medium); Narrative implies directional accumulation but does not specify an immediate trigger; consensus lands on HOLD with a LONG positioning bias already captured in final_signal.
next_move.confirmed_if: Funding spikes above 0.01% OR DXY breaks below 100.5
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows reverse sharply negative OR Fear & Greed drops below 20
